}}'''Guisin''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Gray Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Guisin}}

== Appearance ==
She is a tall woman with silver-gold hair.{{ref/book|9|28}}

== Abilities and Strength ==
Guisin is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|very weak]] for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the [[One Power]] of {{opsl|41}}. We know of only a handful of Aes Sedai that are weaker. She is the same strength as [[Siuan Sanche]] after Siuan was [[Healed]] from [[stilling]].

== Activities ==
She is allied with the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]].{{ref/book|6|15}}

The [[Salidar Six]], led by [[Sheriam]], send Guisin, [[Afara]] and [[Edesina Azzedin]] to Tarabon as emissaries of the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]].{{ref/book|6|15}} All three were captured by the Seanchan and made ''[[damane]]''.{{ref/book|9|19}}

Guisin and Edesina are eventually kenneled with other ''damane'' in the attic of the [[Tarasin Palace]] in [[Ebou Dar]], including [[Teslyn Baradon]] and [[Sheraine Caminelle]], now known as [[Mylen]].{{ref/book|9|19}} Afara was left behind in Tanchico.

Guisin adapts to the life of a ''damane''. When [[Mat Cauthon]] asks Teslyn about the other Aes Sedai among the ''damane'', Teslyn tells him that both Mylen and Guisin would report any escape attempt.{{ref/book|9|19}} Mat later sees all four of the Aes Sedai ''damane'' being walked by ''sul'dam''.{{ref/book|9|28}}
